package deliverycontinuation

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	runtimedelivery "github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/deliverylifecycle"
)

type retireGapStore struct {
	coordinatorTestStore
	once             sync.Once
	entered, release chan struct{}
}

func (s *retireGapStore) ScanDeliveryContinuations(ctx context.Context, authority runtimedelivery.ExecutionAuthority, cursor runtimedelivery.ContinuationCursor, limit int) (runtimedelivery.ContinuationPage, error) {
	first := false
	s.once.Do(func() { first = true })
	if first {
		return runtimedelivery.ContinuationPage{Exhausted: true}, nil
	}
	close(s.entered)
	<-s.release
	return runtimedelivery.ContinuationPage{Exhausted: true, Items: []runtimedelivery.ContinuationItem{{DeliveryID: "retire-gap", Disposition: runtimedelivery.ClaimDeferred}}}, nil
}

func TestRetirementBeforeContextCancellationDoesNotReportFailure(t *testing.T) {
	authority, owner, cleanup := coordinatorTestAuthorityAndOwner(t)
	defer cleanup()
	store := &retireGapStore{entered: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	reported := make(chan error, 1)
	c, err := New(store, coordinatorTestRestarts{}, authority, owner, &coordinatorTestDispatcher{}, func(_ context.Context, err error) { reported <- err })
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := c.Start(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-store.entered:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("scan did not enter")
	}
	// Hold the exact window after Retire publishes retired=true and before its
	// context cancellation. The scan is allowed to return normally in this window.
	cancelEntered, cancelRelease := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	c.mu.Lock()
	originalCancel := c.cancel
	c.cancel = func() { close(cancelEntered); <-cancelRelease; originalCancel() }
	c.mu.Unlock()
	retired := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { retired <- c.Retire(context.Background()) }()
	<-cancelEntered
	close(store.release)
	select {
	case <-c.done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Error("scan did not settle")
	}
	close(cancelRelease)
	if err := <-retired; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case err := <-reported:
		t.Fatalf("normal retirement reported execution failure: %v", err)
	default:
	}
}
